description: This file defines classes and traits related to task results in Apache Spark's scheduler component, including direct and indirect task result representations, serialization/deserialization logic, and handling of task output, accumulator updates, and metrics.

classes.name: TaskResult
classes.description: A sealed trait representing the result of a task, including both direct and indirect results.

classes.name: IndirectTaskResult
classes.description: A case class referencing a stored task result in the worker’s BlockManager, identified by blockId and size.

classes.name: DirectTaskResult
classes.description: A class encapsulating the task's return value, accumulator updates, and metric peaks, with serialization/deserialization support.

methods.name: writeExternal
methods.description: Serializes the DirectTaskResult object to an output stream.

methods.name: readExternal
methods.description: Deserializes the DirectTaskResult object from an input stream.

methods.name: value
methods.description: Returns the deserialized task result value, performing lazy deserialization if necessary.
